scenario_description: A real PaperQA package probe exposes facts needed for candidate inspection.
expected: The canonical package name and selected version are present.
License and advisory fields are present even when their values are empty or unknown.
The response contains a resolved graph summary or an explicit unavailability warning.
No automatic approval verdict is created from metadata alone.
observed: deps.dev resolved canonical paper-qa version 2026.8.12 and retained 169 available versions.
The response exposed license=['non-standard'], advisories=[], source relation, and a 75-node dependency graph with 16 direct dependencies.
No verdict exists in the raw probe; repository license Apache-2.0 was checked separately with GitHub and conflicts with the package metadata classification.
notes: PASS applies only to the ecosystem-intelligence probe contract. Package approval remains blocked on reconciliation of PyPI non-standard versus repository Apache-2.0 license evidence.
